semantic_requirements: every row uses exact price_adjustment_method=close_equals_close_raw_times_adjustment_factor and price_adjustment_convention=provider_cumulative_backward_adjusted_hfq_no_rebasing; close equals close_raw multiplied by a finite positive adjustment_factor within fixed 1e-12 relative and absolute tolerances

close_raw is the supplier-recorded same-session traded close or suspension valuation named by close_observation_type; adjustment_factor is the supplier cumulative corporate-action factor aligned on the exact symbol and official session with no fill, and the canonical adapter applies no rebasing

the provider close_raw definition, adjustment-factor convention, and exact normalization or adapter record each have a distinct human-reviewed evidence SHA-256; row tokens and arithmetic do not substitute for that semantic evidence
multiplying one symbol's full factor history by a positive constant leaves its return ratios unchanged, and cross-sectional price levels are not estimands
close_observation_type is traded_close exactly when is_suspended is false and suspension_valuation exactly when is_suspended is true
every suspension_valuation is a supplier-recorded or supplier-published value for that exact official session; researcher carry-forward or synthetic filling is prohibited

the canonical bound amount is normalized to exact CNY before hashing and every quote row carries amount_unit=CNY; the provider-native unit, conversion method, cutoff timing, and provenance are documented and human-reviewed
